findings.description: ESLint rule '@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any' is explicitly disabled, allowing unbounded use of `any` types throughout the codebase despite strict TypeScript mode being enabled in tsconfig.json.
findings.recommendation: Remove or change '@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any': 'off' to 'warn' or 'error' and systematically replace any types with proper TypeScript interfaces.

findings.description: Unsafe type cast `result.payment_type as any` bypasses TypeScript type system. Payment type enum values should be properly typed.
findings.recommendation: Define a proper union type for payment_type values and use discriminated union pattern instead of casting to any.

findings.description: Unsafe type cast `verifyEvent(event as any)` bypasses TypeScript type checking for Nostr event verification.
findings.recommendation: Import the proper NostrEvent type from the nostr-tools library and type the event parameter correctly.

findings.description: Multiple `any` typed module-level variables for WASM lazy-loading: `let WalletDirector: any`, `let WasmWorkerTransport: any`, `private director: any = null`, `private wallet: any = null`. While WASM dynamic imports make full typing difficult, these variables are entirely untyped.
findings.recommendation: Create interface definitions describing the WASM module API surface and use those types instead of any. At minimum create a WasmWalletDirector interface.

findings.description: LNC WASM client typed as `any`: `let LNC: any = null`, `private lnc: any = null`. Channel mapping also uses `map((ch: any) => ...)` losing type safety on channel data.
findings.recommendation: Use the type definitions from @lightninglabs/lnc-web package for the LNC client. Define a Channel interface for channel mapping.

findings.description: Multiple catch blocks use `catch (e: any)` pattern (lines 267, 509, 671, 710, 955, 978, 1046, 1088, 1175) - 9 instances. Using `e: any` allows accessing error properties without type safety, e.g., `e.message` could fail at runtime.
findings.recommendation: Change `catch (e: any)` to `catch (e: unknown)` and use `instanceof Error` checks: `const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)`.

findings.description: Catch block uses `catch (e: any)` pattern, losing type safety on error handling in the Cashu SDK core logic.
findings.recommendation: Use `catch (e: unknown)` with proper instanceof guards.

findings.description: Catch block uses `catch (e: any)` pattern in NUT-24 ecash paywall logic.
findings.recommendation: Use `catch (e: unknown)` with proper instanceof guards.

findings.description: Catch block uses `catch (e: any)` pattern in community generation pipeline.
findings.recommendation: Use `catch (e: unknown)` with proper instanceof guards.

findings.description: Two catch blocks use `catch (e: any)` pattern (lines 129, 170) in the L402 payment route handler.
findings.recommendation: Use `catch (e: unknown)` with proper instanceof guards for HTTP 500 responses.

findings.description: Catch block uses `catch (e: any)` pattern in community page data loading.
findings.recommendation: Use `catch (e: unknown)` with proper instanceof guards.

findings.description: Catch block uses `catch (e: any)` pattern in cycle alert data fetching.
findings.recommendation: Use `catch (e: unknown)` with proper instanceof guards.

findings.description: Promise chain `.catch(() => {/* DB unavailable — ignore */})` silently swallows database errors. The comment indicates intent but no fallback state is set or user notified.
findings.recommendation: At minimum log the error to a debug channel and/or set an error state to inform the UI that transaction history is unavailable.

findings.description: God component: wallet-panel.tsx is 1,364 lines containing multiple large sub-components inlined: ReceivePanel (~232 lines, lines 226-458), SendPanel (~179 lines, lines 460-639), InvoicePanel (~259 lines, lines 641-900), plus WalletPanel main component (~146 lines). Deep nesting and mixed concerns.
findings.recommendation: Extract ReceivePanel, SendPanel, InvoicePanel, and TransactionList into separate component files. The main WalletPanel should only orchestrate these sub-components.

findings.description: God module: cashu-sdk.ts is 1,905 lines containing 4+ distinct classes: SovereignCashuClient, AgentCashuWallet, AuditedAgentWallet, MultiMintManager (~190 lines). The MultiMintManager class alone handles multi-mint routing, fee optimization, and load balancing.
findings.recommendation: Split into separate modules: cashu-client.ts, agent-cashu-wallet.ts, audited-wallet.ts, multi-mint-manager.ts. This improves testability and maintainability.

findings.description: Large module at 1,108 lines handling multiple distinct concerns: natural language parsing, Docker compose generation, federation config, and deployment templating all in one file.
findings.recommendation: Consider splitting into: prompt-parser.ts, docker-generator.ts, federation-config.ts to separate concerns.

findings.description: TODO comment: 'implement a DB-backed blocklist if immediate revocation is required' - JWT token revocation is not implemented, meaning compromised tokens remain valid until natural expiry.
findings.recommendation: Implement token blocklist using Redis or database. This is a security feature gap for immediate session termination scenarios.

findings.description: TODO comment: NFC provisioning is not implemented - uses manual fulfillment queue instead of Web NFC API. The UI presents NFC card setup as a feature but it is not functional.
findings.recommendation: Either implement Web NFC API integration or update the UI to clearly indicate the feature is 'coming soon' rather than appearing to work.

findings.description: 40+ console.log/warn/error/info statements across 21 production files. While some are appropriate for SDK diagnostic output, many log internal state that should be controlled by a debug flag or logging level.
findings.recommendation: Introduce a structured logger (e.g., a simple Logger class with level controls) or use an environment-gated debug flag: `if (process.env.DEBUG_SDK) console.log(...)`. API routes should use structured logging.

findings.description: Missing test coverage for several key lib modules: lib/grant-templates.ts (534 lines, no test), lib/replication-playbook.ts (553 lines, no test), lib/pilot-deployment.ts (762 lines, no test), lib/bce-metrics.ts has tests but complex cycle signal calculations may lack edge case coverage.
findings.recommendation: Add unit tests for grant-templates.ts, replication-playbook.ts, and pilot-deployment.ts. These are pure transformation functions that are easy to test.

findings.description: Test-to-source ratio: 2,325 LOC tests vs ~20,047 LOC source = ~11.6% test coverage by lines. Unit tests exist for 13 modules but 15+ lib modules have no corresponding test file.
findings.recommendation: Aim for test files covering all lib/ modules. Priority: community-generator.ts (1,108 lines, core business logic), silent-payments.ts (632 lines, cryptographic logic).

findings.description: Inline type assertions and `any` casts in component state management weaken type safety in the largest UI component.
findings.recommendation: Define explicit interfaces for all component state types at the top of the file or in a separate types file.

context.summary: ArxMint has solid TypeScript infrastructure (strict tsconfig) but undermines it by disabling no-explicit-any in ESLint. The codebase has 16 catch-block any-typed errors and 28 files using any. The biggest architectural concern is wallet-panel.tsx (1,364 lines) and cashu-sdk.ts (1,905 lines) as god files needing decomposition. Error handling is present but uses unsafe any-typed catch patterns throughout. Test coverage is reasonable for core lib modules (13 unit test files) but ~15 lib modules have no test coverage. No critical vulnerabilities found - issues are maintainability and type-safety debt.
